name: kanopi/basic-firewall-wp-build-tools
description: Build-only tooling. Kept out of the plugin's own composer.json because the plugin pins config.platform to its PHP floor, and PHP-Scoper does not run there: 0.18 needs PHP 8.2 and its own dependencies need 8.3. The builder's PHP does not affect the zip -- scoping rewrites namespaces in text -- so the two trees are resolved independently.
